# Comments {#comments}

In 0.1 a `%%` line comment ended at the first closer of its frame, so `[a %% b](/u)` was still a link. The 18 November ruling D2 makes a line comment take every closer on its line, and `%%` directly after the opener of a bracket or braced form is text ([#6074](https://github.com/markup-carve/carve/pull/6074), C2-I-023, C2-I-024). Where the HTML check passes, the tool rewrites such a comment as a braced `{% %}` comment.

**U-050** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> `%%%` closer followed by text

::: compare no-render
```text
%%%
hidden
%%% visible?
after
```
```crv
%%%
hidden
visible?
%%%

after
```
:::

**U-072** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Editorial comment that starts like an id
Tool: Review by hand.

::: compare no-render
```text
a*{#b} c #}
```
```html
<p>a*{#b} c #}</p>
```
:::

**U-129** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-B-108, C2-B-110, and C2-B-112, `- a` then ` %%% n`, ` x`, ` %%%`, and ` tail` writes `tail` outside the list in 0.1. In a quoted sequence of three bare percent runs, 0.1 can hide the follower and leave the later line outside the quote.

::: compare no-render
```text
%%%
%%%%
y
```
```crv
%%%%%
%%%%
y
%%%%%
```
:::

**U-155** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-I-034,C2-I-039: in 0.1, `a	%%` writes `<p>a	%%</p>`.
Tool: Review.

::: compare no-render
```text
a	%%
```
```html
<p>a</p>
```

**U-216** <Badge type="tip" text="rewrite" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-I-036 and C2-B-147, `{%%}![alt](x.png)` writes a block image in 0.1, and `![a](/i) %% c` followed by `^ cap` writes a captioned figure.

::: compare no-render

{%%}![alt](x.png)
```
```crv

**U-224** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-B-109 and C2-B-111, a comment block in a container with lines after it that the container does not own: `- ::: box`, `  %%%%`, `%% j`, `  x`; `:: t`, `: d`, `%%%`, `c`, `%%%`, ` : d2`; and `[^n]: head`, a blank line, `  %%%`, `%% below`, a blank line, `  tail`.
Tool: Review the comment block.

::: compare no-render
```text
- ::: box
  %%%%
%% j
  x
```
```text
<ul>
  <li>
    <div class="box">

    </div>
  </li>
</ul>
<p>x</p> A comment block in a container ends where a line falls outside that container (C2-B-111), so `%% j` at column 0 is a line comment of the document and `x` a paragraph after the list; 0.1 kept the later lines in the block and hid `x`. ` : d2` below a comment block in a description and `tail` below one in a note differ the same way. No rewrite is recorded; review.
```
:::

**U-227** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-I-036 and C2-B-108, a line containing `%%%` inside a multiline `{% ... %}` comment remains comment text in 0.1.
Tool: Escape the percent run inside the brace comment, `\%%%`: the list boundary is the 0.1 one, but 0.1 started the item text with a line feed, which no 0.2 source writes (C2-H-069, U-362).

::: compare no-render
```text
- {% a
   %%%
   z %}
plain
```
```crv
- {% a
  \%%%
  z %}
  plain
```
:::

**U-243** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-I-036 and C2-B-108, a line containing three backticks inside a multiline `{% ... %}` comment remains comment text in 0.1.
Tool: Escape the first backtick inside the brace comment, `` \``` ``: the list boundary is the 0.1 one, but 0.1 started the item text with a line feed, which no 0.2 source writes (C2-H-069, U-362).

::: compare no-render
````text
- {% a
   ```
   z %}
plain
````
````crv
- {% a
  \```
  z %}
  plain
````
:::

**U-362** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-B-025, C2-B-140 and C2-H-069, a line of braced comments indented short of the content column after a blank line, with a list marker below it: `- a`, a blank line, ` {%%}`, `  - b`
Tool: The comment line belongs to the item (U-109) and renders nothing, so `- b` is a nested list. With the comment at column 0 the list closes, but a comment line takes its line break with it, so no source writes the leading line feed.

::: compare no-render
```text
- a

 {%%}
  - b
```
<!-- carve-sample {"lint":"the 0.1 source has the same finding: the sample is a fragment"} -->
```crv
- a

{%%}
- b
```
:::

**U-364** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> Under C2-I-026 and C2-I-090, a sigil directly behind a braced comment that follows a letter: `a{%%}#tag`
Tool: The comment counts as nothing, so `#` follows a letter and starts no tag: `<p>a#tag</p>`. A tag glued to a letter has no 0.2 spelling.

::: compare no-render
```text
a{%%}#tag
```
```text
<p>a#tag</p> C2-I-026 tests the characters on the two sides of a braced comment as if they were glued, so `#` follows the letter `a` and starts no tag (C2-I-090). 0.1 read the comment as a boundary and wrote a tag, `<p>a<span class="tag"><strong>#tag</strong></span></p>`. A tag glued to a letter has no 0.2 spelling; a space before the sigil gives the tag behind a space.
```
:::

**U-390** <Badge type="info" text="none" /> A comment marker at the start of a deletion: `{-%% b-}`.

::: compare no-render
```text
{-%% b-}
```
```text
<p><del>%% b</del></p> Under C2-I-023 `%%` directly after a braced opener is text, as in 0.1. No source edit is needed.
```
:::

**U-391** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> A comment fence with no closer in a footnote body: `[^n]: head`, then an indented `%%%`. 0.1 hides the rest of the body, including a later indented `tail`; 0.2 ends the footnote and writes `tail` as a paragraph.
Tool: Report from the comment fence opener through the following unhidden line.

::: compare no-render
```text
[^n]: head

  %%%
%% below

  tail

r[^n]
```
```text
<p>tail</p>
<p>r<a id="fnref1" href="#fn1" role="doc-noteref"><sup>1</sup></a></p>
<section role="doc-endnotes" aria-label="Footnotes">
  <hr>
  <ol>
    <li id="fn1">
      <p>head<a href="#fnref1" role="doc-backlink" aria-label="Back to reference">↩</a></p>
    </li>
  </ol>
</section> A closerless comment fence inside a footnote body changes which later lines are hidden under C2-B-108. Report the source range from the comment fence opener through the following unhidden line.
```
:::

**U-393** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> A line comment inside a substitution, ended in 0.1 at the first raw closer of its frame: `{~a %% b~>c~} d`. 0.1 writes `{~a d`; 0.2 writes `{~a`.
Tool: Report from the comment marker through the end of its line.

::: compare no-render
```text
{~a %% b~>c~} d
```
```text
<p>{~a</p> C2-I-024 makes the line comment take the rest of its line, the substitution arrow, the closer and ` d` included; 0.1 ended the comment at the first raw closer of its frame and wrote `{~a d`. A line comment in any bracket or braced frame whose closer follows on its line changes the same way; U-399 to U-402 rewrite only their own verified sources. Report the source range from the comment marker through the end of its line.
```
:::

**U-394** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> A comment fence opened in a quote, an unquoted `%%` line, and a quoted closer: `> %%%`, `%%`, `> %%%`, `z`. 0.1 writes one empty quote; 0.2 writes two.
Tool: Report from the quoted opener through its matching closer.

::: compare no-render
```text
> %%%
%%
> %%%
z
```
```text
<blockquote>

</blockquote>
<blockquote>

</blockquote>
<p>z</p> The quoted comment fence uses its live container under C2-B-108 and C2-B-032, yielding another empty quote. Report the source range from the quoted opener through its matching closer.
```
:::

**U-395** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> A comment fence line inside a braced comment in a list item: `- p`, `  {% a`, `   %%%`, `   z %}`, `plain`. 0.1 hides the braced comment and keeps `plain` in the item; 0.2 writes `{% a` as text and `plain` as a paragraph after the list.
Tool: Report from the braced comment opener through its closing mark.

::: compare no-render
```text
- p
  {% a
   %%%
   z %}
plain
```
```text
<ul>
  <li>p
{% a</li>
</ul>
<p>plain</p> A comment-fence-shaped line inside a braced comment changes which lines the list retains under C2-B-108 and C2-I-025. Report the source range from the braced comment opener through its closing mark.
```
:::

**U-426** <Badge type="danger" text="report" /> <Badge type="warning" text="silent" /> A line comment directly after the opener of a bracket, an inline note or extension content: `[%% hidden](/u)`. 0.1 hides the comment and writes an empty link; 0.2 writes `%% hidden` as the link text (C2-I-023).
Tool: Report from the `%%` through the closer of its frame.

::: compare no-render
```text
[%% hidden](/u)
```
```text
<p><a href="/u">%% hidden</a></p> C2-I-023 keeps `%%` directly after the opener of a bracket, an inline note or extension content as text; 0.1 read it as a line comment that ended at the closer and wrote an empty link. U-405 to U-407 rewrite only their own verified sources. Report the source range from the `%%` through the closer of its frame.
```
:::
